cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
include($ENV{PICO_SDK_PATH}/external/pico_sdk_import.cmake)
set(TARGET_NAME simple)
project(${TARGET_NAME} C CXX ASM)
pico_sdk_init()
add_executable(${TARGET_NAME} main.c)
pico_set_program_version(${TARGET_NAME} "1.2.3")
set(FIXTURE_BINARY_TYPE "default" CACHE STRING "pico binary type (default, copy_to_ram, ...)")
pico_set_binary_type(${TARGET_NAME} ${FIXTURE_BINARY_TYPE})
target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} pico_stdlib)
pico_add_extra_outputs(${TARGET_NAME})
